category_description: Registered accounts for saving and investing in Canada, and the limits that apply to them.
subcategory_description: Tax-free and tax-deferred accounts for saving, investing and buying a first home.
label: Annual RRSP dollar limit
context: The cap on the amount added to a person's RRSP deduction limit each year. The amount added is the lesser of this figure and 18% of the previous year's earned income.

label: Share of earned income that adds to RRSP room
context: Applied to the previous year's earned income. The amount added is capped at the annual RRSP dollar limit.

label: Over-contribution buffer before the 1% monthly tax applies
context: Generally, a tax of 1% per month applies to contributions that exceed the RRSP deduction limit by more than this amount.

subject_intro: How the RRSP deduction limit is worked out, who can contribute and until what age, and the tax on contributing too much.
subject_meta_description: The RRSP dollar limit is {fact:ca_rrsp_limit}. New room is {fact:ca_rrsp_pct} of earned income up to that. See how the limit is worked out and what over-contributing costs.
